description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
Ablation: same circuit with the carry head removed (carry always 0). Only per-column (a+b) mod 10 is output, so any column that needs a carry-in should fail.
Ablation: carry head only looks at the immediately lower column (c_e = G_{e-1}), with no skipping over propagate (sum=9) columns. Tests whether the propagate-skip lookahead is needed.
Robustness: full carry lookahead circuit with every attention score multiplied by 0.5 (softmax temperature doubled). Checks how sharp the attention must be.
Robustness: full carry lookahead circuit with every attention score multiplied by 0.1 (softmax temperature 10x higher). Checks how sharp the attention must be.
Robustness: full carry lookahead circuit with the B-position gate reduced from 100 to 10. Checks how large the gating weight must be for the pair table.
Ablation: digit-fetch head has no penalty on non-matching B columns (H1_PEN=0). Non-matching columns tie with non-B positions, so their digit sums leak into the output.
Ablation: carry head has no penalty for columns j >= e (GE_PEN=0), so columns above the target digit can be selected as carry source. Tests whether the column-ordering mask is needed.
Ablation: carry head column-mask penalty for j >= e reduced to 20 (from 200). Checks how strong the ordering mask must be relative to the propagate-skip weight.
Ablation: carry head ignores the non-propagate flag (E_W=0), so propagate columns (sum=9) are treated like any other column. Tests whether the propagate-skip term is needed.

Scale check: OUT_W reduced from 2 to 1. Expected argmax-invariant, but it fails (0%): OUT_W also scales the layer-1 X/G/E features, so the ReLU thresholds at 0.5/1.5 no longer fire. The circuit is not scale-invariant.

Robustness: layer-1 partner-fetch match score reduced from 50 to 5 (softmax weight on the matching A digit is about e^5/(e^5+6..10) ~ 0.95 under the causal mask). Checks how sharp the partner fetch must be.
Robustness: layer-1 partner-fetch match score reduced to 1 (matching A digit weight ~ e/(e+6..10) ~ 0.2). Expected to fail: the partner fetch is too diffuse for an exact pair lookup.
Robustness: B-position gate reduced to 1 (from 10). The pair-table bias scales with it, so the non-B gate still sits far below zero. Checks whether the gate needs any magnitude beyond ReLU margin.
Robustness: Gaussian noise (std 0.05) added to every weight after the exact construction. Not training; checks how much weight precision the hand-built circuit tolerates.
Robustness: Gaussian noise (std 0.01) added to every weight after the exact construction. Not training; checks how much weight precision the hand-built circuit tolerates.
Robustness: every attention score multiplied by 0.25 (softmax temperature 4x). Between the 0.5 pass and the 0.1 fail, it locates the sharpness threshold for the carry and fetch heads.
Robustness: every attention score multiplied by 0.15. Narrows the sharpness threshold between the 0.1 fail and the 0.25 pass.
Architecture check: LayerNorm restored (gain 1, bias 0) in every block. The residual stream is no longer an exact linear sum, so the hand-built features are distorted; expected to fail.
Ablation: digit-fetch match bonus reduced from 80 to 40. The matching column's net score falls to 0, tying it with non-B positions, so the fetch should break.
Ablation: propagate-skip weight reduced from 50 to 10 (E_W=10). The skip term now only just beats the column-order term, so ties can occur between eligible and propagate columns.
Ablation: carry column-mask penalty reduced from 200 to 50. Columns above e can still reach scores that beat the eligible-below-e columns, so the carry should be corrupted.
Ablation: layer-1 partner-fetch score set to 0, so the B-position attention is uniform over the causal prefix and the A-digit fetch is lost. Expected to fail.
Robustness: digit-fetch match bonus raised from 80 to 200. A sharper match should not change the result, since the fetched column is already dominant at 80.
Robustness: B-position gate reduced to 0.5. The pair-table threshold is 0.5 above the bias, so the gate and threshold scale together and the lookup should still fire exactly.
Robustness: every attention score multiplied by 2.0 (softmax temperature halved). Sharper attention should preserve the exact argmax, so accuracy should remain 100%.
Robustness: Gaussian noise (std 0.003) added to every weight after the exact construction. Measured between the std 0.01 point (71%) and the noise-free 100% baseline.
Scale check: OUT_W reduced from 2 to 0.5. Like the OUT_W=1 run, this should break the layer-1 X/G/E thresholds rather than be argmax-invariant.
Robustness: Gaussian noise (std 0.001) added to every weight after the exact construction. Smallest noise point, checking that the exact circuit is stable to tiny perturbations.

2-layer hand-built adder without LayerNorm: layer 1 computes per-column generate/propagate via a 10x10 pair lookup; layer 2 uses attention to find the highest non-propagate column below the target digit (carry lookahead) and an MLP lookup to output (digit+carry) mod 10. Verified 200/200.
